title: Google Maps labels do not follow the app language
symptom: You changed the Flutter app language, but the map labels stay the same
cause: Map labels follow the Activity locale. Right after a system language change, GMS caches the locale
fix: Directly: adb shell cmd locale set-app-locales <pkg> --locales ja-JP (verify with get-app-locales)
If tiles are blank, restart the app and Play services
